name: Tinker: Gear Grind deals damage and generates Scrap without a 1H melee weapon (#13716)
contract: Gear Grind (680975 -> 681245 -> 504594) replaces Makeshift Dynamite (572888 rank 7) with a 1.5 s ranged channel (DmgClass 3, EquippedItemClass -1) that triggers 4 ticks of Gear Grind Damage (505160, 0/500/1000/1500 ms via SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD), each dealing Nature damage (base + level + 0.16*RAP) and triggering Generate 1 Scrap (707476 -> +1 stack of 801816). Spell.dbc left stale 1H melee weapon requirements on 505160 (EquippedItemClass 2, EquippedItemInventoryTypeMask 2105344, SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON, DmgClass 2), so Spell::CheckItems rejected every triggered 505160 tick when the Tinker carried only a ranged weapon (or a 2H weapon), letting 504594 channel cleanly with 0 hits, 0 damage and 0 Scrap. A level 80 Tinker with its starting main-hand weapon (431911) destroyed and a level 80 gun (1061370) equipped casts 504594 while Grinding Gears (681245) is active: 504594 must succeed, land all 4 hits of 505160 for positive damage, generate 4 Scrap stacks (801816), and consume 681245.
